stories.headline: Mahomes Saddles Up Full-Go, but He's Ridin' Careful This Year
stories.read: Big news bustin' out of Kansas City, pardner: Patrick Mahomes tore up his knee back in December, but he strode into camp Friday full-cleared and grinnin' like he just struck gold. The whole saloon's fixin' to shove his price up the board now, and rightly so, that's an elite arm back in the saddle. But hold up there, 'cause the man says he aims to run less this go-round, and near a quarter of his fantasy haul last year came from his own two boots scramblin' loose. Load up on his pass-catchers and don't pay top dollar bettin' them legs gush like they used to.

stories.headline: Denver's Backfield Is a Three-Horse Stampede, and That's a Muddy Creek
stories.read: Careful where you pan out west in Denver, pardner. J.K. Dobbins, RJ Harvey, and rookie Jonah Coleman are all fixin' to crowd the same watering hole, and when three horses fight over one trough, nobody drinks their fill. Harvey looked like a real strike closin' out last season, but a three-man carousel splits the haul till the pan comes up mostly gravel. Let the greenhorns reach for that muddle, you keep your powder dry and stake a back who totes the mail alone.

stories.headline: Charbonnet Opens Camp Laid Up, and Seattle's Pecking Order Just Shuffled
stories.read: Word off the Northwest wire, pardner: Zach Charbonnet's still nursin' that busted knee from last winter, and the Seahawks parked him on the laid-up list to open camp. A fella comin' off a blowed-out wheel like that ain't a lock to saddle up Week 1, so his price oughta slide, and that turns him into cheap gold you draft late and let heal in the barn. Meanwhile whoever's totin' the Seattle load out the gate just grabbed a fatter share of the reins, so go pan that vein before the herd wises up.
